versions.changelog:
- Initial release of kenerateai-creative-workflow (v1.0.0)
- Enables planning and review of image, video, and audio generation workflows
- Supports creative briefs, workflow selection, prompt design, prompt audits, and reference-media checks
- Includes optional MCP for structuring briefs, auditing prompts, and accessing Kenerate AI resources
- Lists best practices, rights checks, and canonical resource links for media generation projects
